description: This file defines the AggregatedWorkflowStatus class and the AggregateExecutions function for summarizing workflow execution states, including status determination, time tracking, and counting logic.

classes.name: AggregatedWorkflowStatus
classes.description: Represents the lifecycle summary of a workflow, including status, counts, time metrics, and root execution info.

methods.name: AggregateExecutions
methods.description: Inspects execution and step data to produce a comprehensive lifecycle summary for a workflow.
